title: DOE-UAP-D005, Pantex Unidentified Object Incident Report, 2015
doc_notes: This document is an incident report from the Department of Energy regarding an unidentified object over the Pantex Plant, containing redacted information and references to imagery.

incidents.summary: An unidentified object was detected by Ground Surveillance Radar and observed by Protective Force personnel flying over the Pantex Plant.
incidents.quote: The Lt. and SPO stated that they were unable to identify any type of propulsion system on the object
incidents.shape: diamond type shape, round at the top
incidents.size: approximately 4 ft. tall and 2 ft. wide
